tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H = 0.16–0.48, while the target horizon is 20.7. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish the archived endogenous-reversal mechanism from monotone alternatives and constrain its slow component.

considered_alternatives.option: Dual-horizon adaptation fit from pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow timescale or long-horizon reversal.
Fine short-horizon trajectories are less directly informative about behavior at H = 20.7.
The pilot does not distinguish monotone relaxation from slow adaptation.
